NONE: › having drunk too much alcohol
喝醉的

example: In her inebriated state, she was ready to agree to anything.
她喝醉時任何事情都會答應的。

NONE: C1 not suitable as food
不可食用的，不適合食用的

example: The meat was inedible.
這肉不能吃。

NONE: › causing so much emotion, especially pleasure, that it cannot be described
（尤指喜悅）言語難以表達的，不可言喻的
› not producing the effects or results that are wanted
不起作用的，無效果的，不奏效的

example: They made an ineffective attempt to get the rules changed.
他們試圖改變規則，但未成功。
The army has proved ineffective in protecting the civilian population.
軍隊沒有起到保護平民的作用。

NONE: › not skilled at achieving, or not able to produce, good results
無能力的；不起作用的，無效果的

example: an ineffectual leader
無能的領袖
The teachers were ineffectual at maintaining discipline.
這些老師無力維持紀律。

NONE: C1 not organized, skilled, or able to work in a satisfactory way
低效率的；能力差的

example: Existing methods of production are expensive and inefficient.
現行的生產方法既昂貴效率又低。
I'm hopelessly inefficient at fixing things.
我永遠也不會修理東西。

NONE: › not changing much, or not allowing much change
無變化的，不容許變化的，沒有彈性的

example: For skilled occupations the supply of labour is typically fairly inelastic, because few workers are capable of doing the work.
對於技術性工作來說，勞動力供應的變化通常是比較小的，因為能勝任工作的工人非常少。
The demand for services such as water, gas, and electricity is relatively inelastic.
對於水、燃氣和電力等服務的需求是相對穩定的。

NONE: › not attractive
不雅的；粗俗的

example: an inelegant posture
不雅的姿勢

NONE: › not allowed to do or have something, according to particular rules
無資格的；不合格的

example: He was declared ineligible for the competition because he worked for the company that ran it.
他被宣佈沒有資格參賽，因為他是該比賽主辦公司的工作人員。
Many people became ineligible to receive aid because their earnings were above the new limit.
許多人失掉了領取政府救濟金的資格，因為他們的收入超過了新制定的限額。

NONE: › impossible to avoid
無法躲避的，無法避免的

example: his ineluctable fate
他無法躲避的命運

NONE: › not skilled or effective
無能的；笨拙的；無效的

example: an inept comment/remark
拙劣的評論／談話
He was always rather inept at sport.
他一直不擅長體育運動。
He was criticized for his inept handling of the situation.
他由於對這個局面處理不當而受到批評。
Dick was socially inept and uncomfortable in the presence of women.
迪克不擅長社交，在女性面前顯得局促。

NONE: C2 the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people
不平等，不均等

example: The law has done little to prevent racial discrimination and inequality.
法律在阻止種族歧視和種族不平等方面貢獻很少。
sexual inequality
性別不平等
There remain major inequalities of opportunity in the workplace.
職場上仍存在嚴重的機會不均等問題。

NONE: › not fair
不公正的，不公平的

example: The current healthcare system is inequitable and unjust, with huge disparities between rich and poor.
當前的醫療保健體系非常不公平，對待窮人和富人差距懸殊。

NONE: › the fact that a situation is not fair, or something that is not fair in a situation
不公正，不公平

example: inequities in the healthcare system
醫療保健體系的不公平
gender inequity in the classroom
課堂上的性別不公平

NONE: › not able to be removed
不能根除的；根深蒂固的

example: Some experiences in early life have ineradicable effects.
一些早年的生活經歷對人有著根深蒂固的影響。

NONE: › not moving or not able to move
不動的；不能動的
› not energetic or interesting
無生氣的；無趣的
› specialized chemistry Inert substances do not produce a chemical reaction when another substance is added.
惰性的，不活潑的

example: The inert figure of a man could be seen lying in the front of the car.
可以看到一個男人躺在汽車前座上，一動也不動。
The narrative is inert and sloppy, as if the author had been writing half-asleep.
這個故事既沒有意思又沒有條理，好像作者是在半睡半醒中寫的。

U: › lack of activity or interest, or unwillingness to make an effort to do anything
› specialized physics the physical force that keeps something in the same position or moving in the same direction

example: The organization is stifled by bureaucratic inertia.
官僚主義的惰性扼殺了這個組織。

NONE: › An inertia reel seat belt moves freely but holds you firmly in position if the vehicle stops suddenly.
慣性捲筒（安全帶或座椅安全帶，能自由伸縮，突然受力時可自動收緊以保護使用者）
› the act of sending products to people who have not asked for them, and then demanding payment
慣性銷售（廠商未獲訂購通知便先自行給買主發貨，其後再收款的銷售方法）
› If a fact or a situation is inescapable, it cannot be ignored or avoided.
不可忽視的；不可避免的
› not necessary
非必要的，無關緊要的

example: make-up and other inessential items
化妝品及其他可有可無的東西

NONE: › extremely great, or too great to be described or expressed exactly
無法估價的，極大的，無價的

example: The medical importance of this discovery is of inestimable value.
這項發現的醫學價值是無法估量的。

NONE: C1 certain to happen and unable to be avoided or prevented
不可避免的；必然發生的
› something that is certain to happen and cannot be prevented
不可避免的情況；逃避不了的事實

example: The accident was the inevitable consequence/result/outcome of carelessness.
這次意外是粗心導致的必然結果。
Eventually the inevitable happened and he had a heart attack.
最終不可避免的情況還是發生了，他心臟病發作。

NONE: C1 in a way that cannot be avoided
不可避免地

example: Their arguments inevitably end in tears.
他們的爭論不可避免地以眼淚告終。

NONE: › not exact or not known in detail
不精確的，不準確的

example: Estimates of the numbers involved remain inexact.
有關數量的估計仍然不精確。

NONE: › (of behaviour) too bad to be accepted
（行為）不可原諒的，不可寬恕的

example: His drunken outbursts during the mayor's speech were inexcusable.
市長講話時他醉酒鬧事是不可原諒的。
It's inexcusable that such young children were left in the house alone.
把這麼小的孩子單獨留在家裡是不可原諒的。

NONE: › existing in very great amounts that will never be finished
用不完的，無窮無盡的

example: There seemed to be an inexhaustible supply of champagne at the wedding.
婚禮上似乎有喝不完的香檳。

NONE: › continuing without any possibility of being stopped
不可阻攔的

example: the inexorable progress of science
不可阻擋的科學進步

NONE: › not suitable or convenient
不適當的；不方便的

example: It was inexpedient for him to be seen to approve of the decision.
讓人知道他同意這項決定是不合適的。

NONE: B1 not costing a lot of money
花費不多的，價錢不貴的

example: It's an inexpensive perfume.
這種香水不貴。

NONE: › lack of knowledge or experience
缺乏經驗，不熟練

example: As a leader, he's been criticized for his inexperience in foreign affairs.
作為領袖，他因不熟悉外交事務而受到批評。

NONE: B2 having little knowledge or experience
缺乏經驗的，不熟練的

example: They are young inexperienced parents and need support.
他們是缺乏經驗的年輕父母，需要得到幫助。

NONE: › having little skill
不熟練的；非內行的

example: She had made an inexpert attempt to repair the car.
她笨手笨腳地試圖修理這輛汽車。

NONE: C2 unable to be explained or understood
無法說明的；費解的

example: For some inexplicable reason, he's decided to cancel the project.
由於某種無法解釋的原因，他決定取消這個專案。

NONE: › An inexpressible feeling is too strong to be described.
難以言傳的，無法表達的

example: The news filled him with inexpressible delight/joy/horror/pain.
這消息給他帶來了無法形容的喜悅／高興／恐懼／痛苦。

NONE: › showing no feelings
無表情的；不露感情的

example: Although the shock must have been great, her face remained inexpressive.
儘管受到的震驚一定很大，她仍面無表情。

NONE: › unable to be stopped from burning or existing
不能撲滅的；不可遏制的
› unable to be separated, released, or escaped from
分不開的；無法擺脫的；無法逃離的

example: In the case of King Arthur, legend and truth are often inextricable.
說起亞瑟王，傳說和真相常常交織在一起。
